Script.name: infowindow
Script.script:
--[[ Info Window — port of Solao_Info_Window (MUSHclient) Sean Stoves, 2026-07-31
Pulls every 'INFO: ...' line into its own panel with its colours intact and gags it from the main output. Aardwolf pads INFO with a trailing blank line, so we eat that too. ]]
aardkit = aardkit or {} aardkit.infowin = aardkit.infowin or {}
local IW = aardkit.infowin local U = aardkit.util.named("Info")
local CFG = U.load("infowin", { buffer = 100, gag = true })
local panel = aardkit.panel.new({ name = "info", title = "INFO", width = 460, height = 200, x = "10px", y = "40px", fontSize = 9, })
IW.panel = panel
-- MiniConsole scrollback; Mudlet keeps its own buffer, we just cap it local function apply_buffer() if panel.console then panel.console:setBufferSize(CFG.buffer, math.max(10, math.floor(CFG.buffer / 4))) end end
apply_buffer()
--- -- trigger ---
-- Aardwolf pads INFO with a trailing blank - 93% of them in the logs - so -- gagging the INFO line alone leaves the blank behind. That was a fifth of -- every log file: 2288 blank lines in 10118, and zero INFO lines to show for -- them. -- -- The first attempt armed a tempLineTrigger for the next line to eat it. That -- can't work reliably here: deleteLine() has just removed the current line, so -- "one line from now" is counting from a line that no longer exists, and a -- batch of INFO messages arms several of them at once to fight over the same -- blank. -- -- A flag and a permanent trigger instead. The blank either arrives next or it -- doesn't, and either way nothing is left armed. local eat_blank = false
function IW.capture() panel:capture_line() if CFG.gag then U.gag() -- The padding arrives in the same packet, so the blank trigger below -- always beats this timer. It's here for the 7% that aren't padded, so -- the flag can't sit armed and swallow somebody else's blank later. eat_blank = true tempTimer(0.05, function() eat_blank = false end) end end
-- every blank line comes through here; only one directly after an INFO goes function IW.on_blank() if not eat_blank then return end eat_blank = false U.gag() end
--- -- commands ---
function IW.cmd(arg) local verb, rest = U.split_verb(arg)
if verb == "toggle" then panel:toggle()
elseif verb == "buffer" then local n = tonumber(rest) if not n then U.note("INFO buffer: " .. CFG.buffer .. " lines") elseif n < 10 or n > 5000 then U.warn("Buffer must be 10-5000 lines.") else CFG.buffer = math.floor(n) apply_buffer() U.save("infowin", CFG) U.ok("INFO buffer: " .. CFG.buffer .. " lines.") end
elseif verb == "gag" then CFG.gag = not CFG.gag U.save("infowin", CFG) U.ok("INFO lines are now " .. (CFG.gag and "gagged from" or "kept in") .. " the main window.")
elseif verb == "clear" then panel:clear() U.ok("INFO cleared.")
elseif verb == "show" then panel:show() elseif verb == "hide" then panel:hide() elseif verb == "dock" then panel:setmode("dock") elseif verb == "embed" then panel:setmode("embed")
else U.help("Info Window", { { "infowin toggle", "show or hide the panel" }, { "infowin", "show/hide the panel" }, { "infowin buffer <n>", "scrollback lines to keep (10-5000)" }, { "infowin gag", "toggle gagging INFO from the main window" }, { "infowin clear", "empty the panel" }, { "infowin dock", "pop it out into a dockable window" }, { "infowin embed", "put it back in the main window" }, }) end end
